title: Day 92: DOJ Indicts Two Chinese Nationals for CJNG/Sinaloa Drug Money Laundering; Plan Kukulkan 17 Days to FIFA Opening; El Sapo Hunt Day 92
detail: Day 92 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). DOJ CHINESE NATIONALS INDICTMENT — CJNG/SINALOA FINANCIAL NETWORK (announced May 23, 2026): The U.S. Department of Justice announced federal charges against two Chinese nationals — Ruhuan Zhen and Hongce Wu — for conspiring to launder drug proceeds on behalf of both the CJNG (Jalisco Nueva Generación Cartel) and the Sinaloa Cartel. The indictment documents a transnational money laundering network leveraging Chinese financial conduits to move cartel drug revenues — a well-documented Chinese underground banking pattern used by both major Mexican cartels to convert U.S. drug proceeds into clean assets. The dual-cartel scope (CJNG and Sinaloa simultaneously) is significant: it demonstrates that Chinese financial intermediaries operate across cartel lines, treating them as revenue clients rather than exclusive partners. The indictment represents the DOJ's latest strike against CJNG's financial infrastructure, following: El Menchito sentencing with $6B forfeiture order (March 2025), Gerardo González Valencia / El Cuini network prosecutions (2023–2025), El Jardinero superseding indictment (May 14, 2026), and the ongoing Los Cuinis financial network dismantlement. CJNG's Chinese precursor and laundering networks — documented by DEA and OFAC throughout 2024–2026 — are a persistent structural vulnerability even under O3's leadership. (Townhall / DOJ announcement — May 23, 2026.) EL SAPO HUNT — DAY 92 (NO CAPTURE): Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán ('El Sapo' / 'El 090') remains at large as Mexico's Federal Security Cabinet top-priority CJNG enforcement target. No confirmed operation, arrest, or elimination reported on Day 92. His capture or elimination before June 11 remains Mexico's stated top CJNG enforcement objective for the final Plan Kukulkan phase. PLAN KUKULKAN — 17 DAYS: Seventeen days remain before the FIFA World Cup 2026 opening match (June 11, Estadio Azteca, Mexico City vs. South Africa). Mexico has deployed 100,000+ security personnel — 20,000 military + 55,000 police and private security + 2,500 vehicles + 24 aircraft + anti-drone systems + bomb-detection units. Guadalajara (Akron Stadium, 4 group-stage matches) remains under heightened CJNG-specific protocols. U.S. special forces have been confirmed training Mexican military on stadium attack prevention and drone bomb defense (KVIA, May 21). MANZANILLO COMMAND VOID — DAY 16: Sixteen days since El Chucky's arrest (May 9) with no confirmed successor plaza boss. Port operations continue under SEMAR surveillance. CIAGATE FGR INVESTIGATION — DAY 92: Ongoing. Mullin-Sheinbaum June meeting framework active; 'coordination without subordination' established as bilateral governing principle (May 22). Two FGR criminal investigation lines (federal jurisdiction invasion + possible treason) continue in parallel. DECAPITATION LEDGER — DAY 92: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Doble R (arrested March 11), El Jardinero (arrested April 27; DOJ superseding indictment May 14; extradition suspended May 15), El Güero Conta (arrested April 27), El Chipo/Jorge N (arrested May 19), El Cabo (arrested May 7; vinculado a proceso May 14; Lagos de Moreno linked), El Chucky/Manzanillo plaza (arrested May 9), El Checo/Tecate regional (arrested May 13). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials detained. 47+ CJNG HVTs neutralized. SUCCESSION BINARY: El 03 (confirmed leader, financial wing) vs. El Sapo (military wing, at large). DOJ FINANCIAL NETWORK PRESSURE: Chinese nationals indictment (May 23) + El Jardinero superseding indictment (May 14) + Los Cuinis prosecution history = sustained multi-front pressure on CJNG's transnational financial infrastructure.

media.caption: U.S. DOJ indicts two Chinese nationals for laundering drug proceeds for both CJNG and Sinaloa Cartel — extends financial network dismantlement to transnational Chinese underground banking channels
Plan Kukulkan — 17 days to FIFA World Cup 2026 opening (June 11); Guadalajara's Akron Stadium hosts 4 CJNG-heartland matches; 100,000+ security personnel deployed
